name: always-click-yes
description: Supervise long-running Claude Code tasks: plan, arm, and let acy approve each permission prompt on a countdown — right in a VS Code terminal.

acy.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `acy` binary. Leave empty to use the binary bundled with a platform-specific build of this extension, or `acy` from your `PATH`.

acy.defaults.markdownDescription: Seed values for **ACY: Create .acy.json**. Only values set here make it into the file — and once the file exists, *it* is the source of truth: these settings are never consulted at launch.

model.description: Model alias or name (e.g. sonnet, opus).

countdown.description: Auto-approve delay per gated tool, as a Go duration string (e.g. 20s).

maxLines.description: Max lines shown per tool call/result/thinking block.

planTools.description: The built-in tool registry for the supervising session, in both phases (default: Read, Grep, Glob). Anything left out cannot be called at all — that is what keeps the session you talk to unable to change your code. Dispatched children always get the full set.

childModel.description: Model for dispatched tasks; empty means the same as model. Often the biggest saving available, since children do the bulk of the tokens.

taskBudget.description: Spend ceiling in USD for a single dispatched task (0 = none). A runaway child stops instead of running until you notice.

useApiKey.description: Bill ANTHROPIC_API_KEY instead of the claude.ai login.
